d: Bihar men endie (NDA) sarkar ka 1 sal ka karyakal saphaltapurvak pura hone ke uplakshy men pradhanmantri narendr modi ke prastavit bihar daure ko lekar janta dal yunaited (JDU) men jabardast utsah hai. jediyu ke pradesh adhyaksh umesh kushvaha ne piem modi ke is daure ko rajy ke lie atyant garv ka pal karar diya hai.
